name: St. Regis La Bahia Blanca Resort, Tamuda Bay
positioning: Riad-inspired St. Regis beach resort on Morocco's Mediterranean coast at Tamuda Bay, where the sea meets the Rif Mountains
best_for: Travelers who want a private-beach Mediterranean resort in northern Morocco
Guests drawn to Moroccan craft, art and design
Families looking for cooking classes for adults and children

facts.text: The resort sits where the Mediterranean Sea meets the Rif Mountains.
The resort is about 20 minutes from Sania Ramel Airport in Tetouan.
The architecture is reminiscent of traditional riads.
The resort's design draws on Andalusian and Moroccan heritage.
Every suite has a private terrace or balcony with sea views.
Rooms feature handmade furniture, locally sourced linens and curated local artwork.
Baie Blanche Brasserie blends French and Moroccan cooking.
The resort serves fresh seafood caught daily by local suppliers.
The spa's hammam ritual includes a black soap cleanse and a ghassoul clay wrap.
The resort has a private beach.
Cooking classes with the culinary team are designed for both adults and children, and can be booked through the butler.
Guests can explore the ancient ruins at the archaeological site of Tamuda.

highlights.text: Each evening at seven o'clock the head bartender performs a Champagne sabrage ritual at The St. Regis Bar.
The resort showcases the art of Tetouan multidisciplinary artist Amine Asselman.
The resort's own Bahia Mary cocktail features regional spices, local harissa sauce, rosemary and black pepper.
The Moroccan Crea boutique sells caftans, ready-to-wear and beauty essentials designed exclusively for the resort.
The heated outdoor pool can be used for swimming even during the winter months.

considerations.text: The resort is on the coast outside Tetouan, about 20 minutes from Sania Ramel Airport; the concierge arranges chauffeured transfers to and from Tetouan Airport, Tangier Airport or Tangier Train Station.
WhataHotel notes the remote location may require longer transfers from airports.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing that reflects the resort's premium positioning.
